title: inspeximus fact-record interchange — schema_v0
description: Open, composable-not-coupled interchange for agentic memory. inspeximus emits a fact record on the WRITE side (corroboration counting + deterministic (subject,relation) supersession key + bi-temporal valid_from/recorded_at). A read-side ledger (e.g. MemStrata, arXiv:2606.26511) ingests the record, owns the bitemporal transaction boundary, and returns a synchronous ack-by-id so the writer knows the fact was durably committed. A plain vector store may ingest the same record and ignore fields it does not use. inspeximus also runs standalone (its own (subject,relation) supersession drives stale recall to 0% without any external ledger); in that mode `status` is authoritative, in a combined deployment the read-side ledger overrides it. Versioned so both sides code against one thing.

source.description: An entity-resolved DISTINCT origin of the fact (sybil-collapsed: repetitions from one principal count once).

channel.description: origin kind, e.g. tool | doc | user | api

principal.description: the resolved distinct actor/source id, e.g. 'kms:rotate-job', 'runbook#auth'

fact_record.description: What a inspeximus write emits (this is what the runnable probes output).

id.description: write-side record id (echoed back in the ack). STORED.

valid_from.description: event-time (bitemporal VALID-time): when the fact became true. STORED.

recorded_at.description: ingest/system-time: when the writer recorded it (inspeximus's `ts`). Both timestamps are emitted so the READ-side owns the transaction boundary. STORED.

key.description: (subject, relation) identifier, e.g. 'billing-api::auth-method' — the deterministic supersession key (no similarity threshold, no LLM). STORED; null for non-keyed facts.

object.description: the current value for (subject, relation). NOT stored separately by inspeximus (the value lives in `text`); null unless the caller separates it — read `text`.

text.description: the fact, carrying the value. STORED.

sources.description: DERIVED: this record's `source` + its corroborating links' sources, entity-deduped.

corroboration_count.description: DERIVED: number of DISTINCT sources (record + links), not repetitions.

effective_value.description: DERIVED: value * 0.5^(age / type_half_life), clock reset on access (not on write).

status.description: inspeximus's LOCAL/standalone view. STORED; in a combined deployment the read-side ledger is authoritative and overrides this.

ingest_ack.description: Synchronous ack-by-id the READ-side ledger returns on ingest (NOT fire-and-forget), so the writer knows the fact was durably committed and did not vanish in transit. Strict auditability: the ledger's own committed ids come back.

ledger_record_id.description: the read-side ledger's committed record id

transaction_id.description: the bitemporal transaction id that owns valid_from + recorded_at

fact_record.subject: billing-api
fact_record.text: The billing API authenticates with API keys.
